phases.label: Foundation
phases.focus: Movement quality, moderate intensity, build patterns

phases.label: Load
phases.focus: Volume increases, heavier loads, conditioning spikes

phases.label: Deload
phases.focus: Intentional recovery, movement quality, benchmark retest

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.cue: Easy pace. Relaxed shoulders. Get blood moving.

exercises.name: Hip Circle + Leg Swing
exercises.cue: 10 hip circles each direction, then 10 leg swings forward/back each side.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge Hold
exercises.cue: 2-second pause at top each rep. Drive hips fully extended.

exercises.name: KB Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Slow 3-sec descent. Pause at bottom. Drive knees out. Chest tall.

exercises.name: Single-Leg KB Romanian Deadlift (Right)
exercises.cue: Hinge from hip, slight knee bend. Control the lowering. Keep back flat.

exercises.name: Single-Leg KB Romanian Deadlift (Left)
exercises.cue: Hinge from hip, slight knee bend. Control the lowering. Keep back flat.

exercises.name: KB Suitcase Carry (Right)
exercises.cue: Tall posture. Resist lateral lean. 40 yards each side.

exercises.name: KB Suitcase Carry (Left)
exercises.cue: Tall posture. Resist lateral lean. 40 yards each side.

exercises.name: TRX Split Squat (Right)
exercises.cue: Rear foot in TRX. Knee tracks over toe. Full depth. Controlled.

exercises.name: TRX Split Squat (Left)
exercises.cue: Rear foot in TRX. Knee tracks over toe. Full depth. Controlled.

exercises.name: Plyo Box Step-Up (Right)
exercises.cue: Vest on. Drive through heel on box. Controlled step down.

exercises.name: Plyo Box Step-Up (Left)
exercises.cue: Vest on. Drive through heel on box. Controlled step down.

sections.name: Core Tabata
sections.tabataNote: 4 exercises x 2 rounds = 8 min. 20 sec on / 10 sec off. Rest 60 sec between rounds.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.cue: Lower back pressed to floor. Arms overhead. Hold the dish shape.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.cue: Explosive drive. Hips level. Drive knees to chest alternating.

exercises.name: Dead Bug (Alternating)
exercises.cue: Controlled tempo. Breathe out on extension. Back flat to floor.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.cue: Minimize hip rotation. Core locked. Tap alternating shoulders.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Lunge position. Tall spine. Posterior pelvic tilt. Breathe into it.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Lunge position. Tall spine. Posterior pelvic tilt. Breathe into it.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Lying or seated. Pull shin toward chest. Feel glute.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Lying or seated. Pull shin toward chest. Feel glute.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.cue: Arms extended. Breathe into lower back. Full release.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine Easy
exercises.cue: Rate 18-20. Legs-back-arms sequence. Easy effort.

exercises.name: KB Halo
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled. 5 each direction. Core tight.

exercises.name: Inchworm to Push-Up
exercises.cue: Walk hands out, one push-up, walk back. Open hips.

exercises.name: KB Two-Hand Swing
exercises.cue: Hip hinge drive. Glutes fire at top. Bell eye-level. Explosive hip snap.

exercises.name: KB Clean + Press (Right)
exercises.cue: Clean to rack, stable base, vertical press. Wrist straight at top.

exercises.name: KB Clean + Press (Left)
exercises.cue: Clean to rack, stable base, vertical press. Wrist straight at top.

exercises.name: Plyo Box Jump
exercises.cue: Soft landing. Absorb with hips. Step down — never jump down.

exercises.name: KB Snatch (Right)
exercises.cue: Hip-driven. Punch through at top. Control descent between legs.

exercises.name: KB Snatch (Left)
exercises.cue: Hip-driven. Punch through at top. Control descent between legs.

exercises.name: Sandbag Shouldering (Right)
exercises.cue: Load from ground to shoulder. Drive with hips. Control down.

exercises.name: Sandbag Shouldering (Left)
exercises.cue: Load from ground to shoulder. Drive with hips. Control down.

sections.name: Core HIIT
sections.tabataNote: KB Windmill 30 sec each side x3. V-Up 20/10 x4 rounds. ~7 min total.

exercises.name: KB Windmill (Right)
exercises.cue: Press locked. Hinge laterally. Eyes on the bell the whole way.

exercises.name: KB Windmill (Left)
exercises.cue: Press locked. Hinge laterally. Eyes on the bell the whole way.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.cue: Full crunch. Touch toes at top. Controlled lowering. 10 sec rest between.

exercises.name: Forearm-to-Floor Lunge Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Hip flexor and thoracic opener. Rotate upper body toward front leg.

exercises.name: Forearm-to-Floor Lunge Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Hip flexor and thoracic opener. Rotate upper body toward front leg.

exercises.name: Thread-the-Needle (Right)
exercises.cue: From all-fours. Rotate arm under and through. Hold.

exercises.name: Thread-the-Needle (Left)
exercises.cue: From all-fours. Rotate arm under and through. Hold.

exercises.name: Doorframe Chest Stretch
exercises.cue: Arms at 90 degrees. Lean through doorframe. Open chest.

exercises.name: Warm-Up Row
exercises.cue: Rate 18. Focus on technique. Legs-back-arms.

exercises.name: Row Interval x8 — 500m Hard
exercises.cue: Hard effort. Rate 26-28. 90 sec rest between each 500m.

exercises.name: Cool-Down Row
exercises.cue: Rate 16. Long smooth strokes. Bring HR down.

exercises.name: Easy Jog Warm-Up
exercises.cue: Conversational pace. Shake out legs.

exercises.name: Tempo Run x4 — 5 min Hard
exercises.cue: Hard but sustainable. 7/10 effort. 90 sec walk between each.

exercises.name: Easy Jog Cool-Down
exercises.cue: Drop pace. Shake out legs. Big slow breaths.

exercises.name: Warm-Up Spin
exercises.cue: Low resistance. Cadence 80-90 rpm.

exercises.name: Bike Interval x5 — 4 min Hard
exercises.cue: RPE 8. Hard effort. 2 min easy spin recovery between each.

exercises.name: Easy Spin Cool-Down
exercises.cue: Light resistance. Breathe down. Spin loose.

exercises.name: Cardio Warm-Up
exercises.cue: Easy effort on chosen modality. Rate 18 row / conversational run / 80rpm bike.

exercises.name: Main Cardio Intervals
exercises.cue: Row 8x500m / Run 4x5min tempo / Bike 5x4min hard. See options above.

exercises.name: Cardio Cool-Down
exercises.cue: Easy effort. Bring heart rate below 120 bpm before stopping.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Slow tempo. Squeeze shoulder blades at end range.

exercises.name: TRX Y-T-W Drill
exercises.cue: Body at 45 degrees. Controlled movement through Y, T and W positions.

exercises.name: Arm Circles + Cross-Body Stretch
exercises.cue: 10 forward, 10 back, then 30 sec each side cross-body stretch.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Full hang to chin over bar. Dead hang between reps. Vest on.

exercises.name: TRX Inverted Row
exercises.cue: Body straight as a board. Pull elbows back hard. Pause at top.

exercises.name: KB One-Arm Row (Right)
exercises.cue: Brace on bench. Full range of motion. Don't rotate hips.

exercises.name: KB One-Arm Row (Left)
exercises.cue: Brace on bench. Full range of motion. Don't rotate hips.

exercises.name: Sandbag Rotational Clean (Right)
exercises.cue: Rotate from hips. Explosive hip drive. Not shoulders.

exercises.name: Sandbag Rotational Clean (Left)
exercises.cue: Rotate from hips. Explosive hip drive. Not shoulders.

exercises.name: Kickboxing Bag — Cross-Hook Combo
exercises.cue: Rotate through hips on cross. Stay light on feet. Aggressive.

sections.name: Core Tabata
sections.tabataNote: Russian Twist 20/10 x4 + Side Plank 30 sec each side x2 + Bicycle 20/10 x4 = 8 min.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Weighted)
exercises.cue: Feet off floor. Rotate to touch floor each side. Control it.

exercises.name: Side Plank (Right)
exercises.cue: Hip lifted. Body straight. Breathe.

exercises.name: Side Plank (Left)
exercises.cue: Hip lifted. Body straight. Breathe.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled. Quality over speed. Full rotation.

exercises.name: Doorframe Pec Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Elbow at 90 degrees. Feel stretch across chest. Breathe.

exercises.name: Doorframe Pec Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Elbow at 90 degrees. Feel stretch across chest. Breathe.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch on Pull-Up Bar
exercises.cue: Hang with slight lean away. Breathe into the lat.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension on Bench Edge
exercises.cue: Upper back on bench edge. Arms fall overhead. Open chest. Breathe.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine Easy
exercises.cue: Build effort gradually.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.cue: Each side. Lunge + thoracic rotation + hip opener all in one.

exercises.name: Plyo Box Lateral Step-Over
exercises.cue: Quick feet. Stay light and athletic. Each side.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.cue: Power from hips. Bell shoulder height at top. Explosive.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Max reps. Dead hang start. Control the negative.

exercises.name: Sandbag Bear Hug Squat
exercises.cue: Hug sandbag to chest. Squat deep. Chest tall.

exercises.name: Kickboxing Bag — Jab-Cross-Kick
exercises.cue: Stay aggressive. Rotate hips on kick. Light on feet.

exercises.name: Plyo Box Jump + Step Down
exercises.cue: Jump explosively. Always step down to protect knees. Reset each rep.

sections.name: Core Finisher
sections.tabataNote: 2 rounds: 15 hollow body rollouts + 3 Turkish get-ups each side. Full core integration.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rollout (or Hold)
exercises.cue: Slow out and back. If no wheel, hold hollow body 30 sec.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Right)
exercises.cue: Slow and deliberate. KB locked overhead throughout. No rushing.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Left)
exercises.cue: Slow and deliberate. KB locked overhead throughout. No rushing.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Right)
exercises.cue: Deep hip opener. Breathe into the tension. Don't force it.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Left)
exercises.cue: Deep hip opener. Breathe into the tension. Don't force it.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist (Right)
exercises.cue: Shoulders flat. Let gravity do the work.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist (Left)
exercises.cue: Shoulders flat. Let gravity do the work.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold
exercises.cue: Bend knees slightly. Let head hang heavy. Full release.

exercises.name: Jump Rope — Fast/Slow Intervals
exercises.cue: 30 sec fast / 30 sec easy x3. Prime fast-twitch from the start.

exercises.name: Banded Good Morning
exercises.cue: Band anchored underfoot. Hinge from hip. Feel hamstrings load.

exercises.name: KB Deadlift (Double KB)
exercises.cue: Hinge not squat. Drive the floor away. Lock hips and glutes at top.

exercises.name: KB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Slow 4-sec descent. Feel hamstring load at bottom. Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: KB Rack Carry (Right)
exercises.cue: KB in rack position. Don't let elbow flare out. Tall posture.

exercises.name: KB Rack Carry (Left)
exercises.cue: KB in rack position. Don't let elbow flare out. Tall posture.

exercises.name: BOSU Single-Leg RDL (Right)
exercises.cue: BOSU dome down for instability. Slow and controlled. Balance challenge.

exercises.name: BOSU Single-Leg RDL (Left)
exercises.cue: BOSU dome down for instability. Slow and controlled. Balance challenge.

exercises.name: Sandbag Shouldering + Walk (Right)
exercises.cue: Shoulder the bag. Walk 10 yards. Lower. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Sandbag Shouldering + Walk (Left)
exercises.cue: Shoulder the bag. Walk 10 yards. Lower. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rock
exercises.cue: Arms overhead. Maintain dish shape. Rock forward and back.

exercises.name: KB Around-the-Body Pass
exercises.cue: Feet off floor. Pass KB in circle around body. Alternate direction each set.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip (Right)
exercises.cue: Hip up and down. Controlled. No momentum.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip (Left)
exercises.cue: Hip up and down. Controlled. No momentum.

exercises.name: Dead Bug with KB Hold
exercises.cue: Hold light KB at ceiling. Extend opposite arm and leg slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: One leg extended. Hinge forward at hip. Not the back.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: One leg extended. Hinge forward at hip. Not the back.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Back knee down. Shift forward. Tuck pelvis under.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Back knee down. Shift forward. Tuck pelvis under.

exercises.name: Ruck Walk — Brisk
exercises.cue: 25lb vest. Tall posture. Long stride. Set the pace.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.cue: Pull to forehead level. Rotate wrists at end position.

sections.name: EMOM x16 min
sections.emomNote: 4-exercise EMOM rotating every minute. 4 rounds = 16 min. Rest is what remains in each minute.

exercises.name: EMOM Min 1 — Sandbag Clean
exercises.cue: Explosive hip extension. Pull bag to rack position. 8 reps in under 45 sec.

exercises.name: EMOM Min 2 — Plyo Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands leave floor at top. Land soft. 10 reps in under 45 sec.

exercises.name: EMOM Min 3 — KB One-Arm Swing (Right + Left)
exercises.cue: 8 right then 8 left within the minute. Hard hip drive each rep.

exercises.name: EMOM Min 4 — Plyo Box Lateral Jump
exercises.cue: Side to side over box. Stay bouncy. 10 total in under 45 sec.

sections.name: Core HIIT
sections.tabataNote: 3 exercises x 3 rounds each = ~7 min. 20 on / 10 off.

exercises.name: Sandbag Drag (Plank)
exercises.cue: In plank position. Drag bag side to side underneath you.

exercises.name: V-Up Crunch
exercises.cue: Arms overhead. Simultaneous leg and torso rise. Touch toes at top.

exercises.name: Plank Walkout
exercises.cue: From standing, walk hands to full plank and back. Controlled.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Ear to shoulder. Hand on top adds gentle pressure.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Ear to shoulder. Hand on top adds gentle pressure.

exercises.name: Chest Opener on Bench
exercises.cue: Lying face-up on bench. Arms fall overhead. Breathe.

exercises.name: Supine Knee-to-Chest (Right)
exercises.cue: Pull knee to chest. Breathe into lower back.

exercises.name: Supine Knee-to-Chest (Left)
exercises.cue: Pull knee to chest. Breathe into lower back.

exercises.name: Cardio Warm-Up
exercises.cue: Easy effort. Row rate 18 / conversational run / easy spin.

exercises.name: Steady-State Cardio
exercises.cue: Row 25 min at rate 22-24 targeting 2:05-2:15/500m. Or run negative split (first 10 easy, last 10 building). Or bike Zone 3 steady.

exercises.name: Cardio Cool-Down
exercises.cue: Drop effort. Bring HR below 120. Long slow breaths.

exercises.name: TRX Row + Y-Raise Combo
exercises.cue: Row, then release and raise to Y position. Smooth transition.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart + Overhead
exercises.cue: Pull apart at chest then raise overhead. Full range.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Controlled negative — 3 sec down. Full hang each rep. Vest on.

exercises.name: KB One-Arm Push Press (Right)
exercises.cue: Rack position. Slight knee drive. Vertical press. Wrist straight.

exercises.name: KB One-Arm Push Press (Left)
exercises.cue: Rack position. Slight knee drive. Vertical press. Wrist straight.

exercises.name: TRX Atomic Push-Up
exercises.cue: Feet in TRX. Push-up then drive knees to chest. Hard combo.

exercises.name: Kickboxing Bag — 3 min Round
exercises.cue: Jab-cross-hook-uppercut combos. Work angles. Stay on toes.

sections.name: Core Tabata
sections.tabataNote: 4 exercises x 2 rounds. 20 on / 10 off. 8 min total.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.cue: From pull-up bar. Knees to chest. Lower controlled. Max reps in 20 sec.

exercises.name: Windshield Wipers
exercises.cue: Lying. Legs up. Rotate side to side slowly. Control the movement.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold
exercises.cue: Parallel bars or chairs. Legs parallel to floor. Arms locked. Brutal.

exercises.name: Plank Up-Down
exercises.cue: Plank to push-up alternating. Keep hips perfectly level.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Arm extended palm out. Press fingers back gently. Hold.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Arm extended palm out. Press fingers back gently. Hold.

exercises.name: Upper Trap Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Tilt head away. Hand on top adds gentle weight.

exercises.name: Upper Trap Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Tilt head away. Hand on top adds gentle weight.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Lateral Reach (Right)
exercises.cue: Reach arms to right. Breathe into lat and oblique.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Lateral Reach (Left)
exercises.cue: Reach arms to left. Breathe into lat and oblique.

workouts.title: Fight-Style AMRAP Benchmark
workouts.benchmarkNote: Record total rounds. Retest this exact workout in Week 6 to measure your progress.

exercises.name: Jump Rope Freestyle
exercises.cue: Mix speeds. Alternate footwork patterns. Get loose.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Both legs at 90 degrees. Lean over front shin.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Both legs at 90 degrees. Lean over front shin.

sections.name: 20-min AMRAP
sections.amrapNote: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes. Record your total. This is your benchmark.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Strict. If fading use 3. Quality over quantity. Dead hang.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.cue: 50lb. Hard and explosive every single rep.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cue: Chest to floor. Full lockout at top. No worming.

exercises.name: 200m Run or 1 min Row
exercises.cue: Hard effort. Push this leg every round. Don't coast it.

sections.name: Core Finisher
sections.tabataNote: 2 rounds: sandbag sit-up press + max plank hold. Rest 30 sec between rounds.

exercises.name: Sandbag Sit-Up + Press
exercises.cue: Hold bag at chest. Sit up. Press overhead at top. Control down.

exercises.name: Plank Hold — Max Time
exercises.cue: Breathe slowly. Squeeze glutes and quads. Hold until failure.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Right)
exercises.cue: Intense workout today earns this. Breathe deep into the hip.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Left)
exercises.cue: Intense workout today earns this. Breathe deep into the hip.

exercises.name: Lying Quad Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Side lying. Pull heel to glute. Don't arch lower back.

exercises.name: Lying Quad Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Side lying. Pull heel to glute. Don't arch lower back.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Pose
exercises.cue: Grab outsides of feet. Rock gently side to side. Full release.

weeks.label: Week 3 — Load (Volume Up)
weeks.progressionNote: Add 5-10% load to all KB and sandbag movements vs Week 1. Pull-up reps +1 per set.

workouts.title: Cardio — Build Intervals
workouts.progressionNote: Rowing: add 2 more 500m intervals (10 total). Running: add 1 tempo interval. Bike: extend intervals to 5 min.

weeks.label: Week 4 — Load (Heavier + Longer)
weeks.progressionNote: Add another 5-10% load. Push sets to near failure on final set. Cardio interval count up again.

workouts.title: Cardio — Peak Distance
workouts.progressionNote: Longest cardio session. Row 30 min steady / Run 6x5min / Bike 6x4min.

workouts.title: Fight-Style AMRAP — Push For PR
workouts.progressionNote: Same AMRAP as Week 2 Saturday. Aim for more rounds than your benchmark.

weeks.label: Week 5 — Peak (Maximum Effort)
weeks.progressionNote: Heaviest week. Max safe load on all compound movements. Shorter rest. Higher intensity.

workouts.title: Cardio — Peak Effort
workouts.progressionNote: Best effort cardio. Row: 10x500m. Run: 5x5min at 8/10 effort. Bike: 6x4min at max sustainable.

workouts.title: Peak Circuit — Max Rounds
workouts.progressionNote: Same AMRAP structure. This is your PR attempt before deload. Leave everything in the gym.

weeks.label: Week 6 — Deload + Benchmark Retest
weeks.progressionNote: Drop load to 60-70% of Week 5. Focus on movement quality. Retest AMRAP benchmark on Saturday.

workouts.title: Cardio — Easy Active Recovery
workouts.progressionNote: Easy Zone 2 only. Row or bike 30 min at conversational pace. No intervals. Recovery focus.

workouts.title: AMRAP Benchmark Retest
workouts.benchmarkNote: Same exact workout as Week 2 Saturday. Compare your rounds. This is your 6-week result.

exercises.name: Jump Rope Freestyle
exercises.cue: Mix speeds. Get loose. This is your test day.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch (Right)
exercises.cue: Hips open and ready.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch (Left)
exercises.cue: Hips open and ready.

sections.name: 20-min AMRAP — Benchmark Retest
sections.amrapNote: RETEST: Same as Week 2 Saturday. Record rounds and compare to your benchmark. This is your 6-week result.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Strict. Same standard as Week 2. Dead hang every rep.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.cue: 50lb. Same weight as Week 2. Explosive every rep.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cue: Chest to floor. Full lockout. Same standard.

exercises.name: 200m Run or 1 min Row
exercises.cue: Same modality as Week 2 if possible. Hard effort.

sections.name: Core Finisher
sections.tabataNote: Final core session of the program. 2 rounds.

exercises.name: Sandbag Sit-Up + Press
exercises.cue: Last session of the program. Bring everything.

exercises.name: Plank Hold — Max Time
exercises.cue: Beat your previous max. Six weeks stronger.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Right)
exercises.cue: Six weeks of work. You earned this. Breathe deep.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Left)
exercises.cue: Six weeks of work. You earned this. Breathe deep.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist (Right)
exercises.cue: Decompress the spine. Full release.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist (Left)
exercises.cue: Decompress the spine. Full release.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall
exercises.cue: 2 full minutes. Breathe. Reflect on 6 weeks of work. You did it.
